recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Do not re-add or edit ShareableValueSet in the FHIR core checkout for this issue; any future profile-definition correction should be made in CRMI or through a new tracker that explicitly reverses FHIR-37959.
issue_request: FHIR-29943 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab request for R5 to stop requiring ShareableValueSet.publisher because VSD-P author/steward extensions may carry that information, and to consider whether description should also stop being required if VSD-P scope guidance replaced it.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly cites FHIR-29943. The requested publisher cardinality change appears in R5 profile history: commits 9fca6ca36f and 054eabf311 removed explicit 1..1 min/max constraints from ValueSet.publisher and ValueSet.description in source/valueset/structuredefinition-profile-shareablevalueset.xml, and b0172dd266 removed the publisher steward alias. Later FHIR-31395 work in 93fadfaa2a rebuilt the ValueSet profile family with ShareableValueSet.publisher non-required/mustSupport and ShareableValueSet.description 1..1/mustSupport.
additional_context: The VSD-P resource element list cites FHIR-29943/FHIR-29944 for the publisher concern. FHIR-34171 and FHIR-35989 later handled the scope/description question by aligning scope with ValueSet.description guidance rather than making current core Shareable.description optional. FHIR-37959 then removed the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable profiles from core for R6 and moved ongoing maintenance to CRMI with unchanged canonical URIs.
reconciliation: No current core source change is appropriate. source/fhir.ini has no active ShareableValueSet profile entry, source/valueset/structuredefinition-profile-shareablevalueset.xml was deleted by 3958dd1e7c, and the active Shareable logical pattern already has publisher 0..1 with SHOULD-level guidance rather than a required cardinality.

related_jiras.note: Companion VSD-P publisher/steward wording issue cited in the same Confluence row; not decided because the remaining current-core wording is broader than the removed ShareableValueSet cardinality issue.
Rebuilt ShareableValueSet and the ValueSet profile family, preserving non-required publisher while keeping description required.
Later VSD-P decision records that scope should further clarify ValueSet.description.
Later VSD-P decision updates ValueSet.description guidance and says description SHOULD be provided unless context supplies it.
Removed the terminology-resource profile family from core for R6 and moved ongoing maintenance to CRMI.
